verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a server runtime, not a desktop app. It runs from a CLI binary or Docker container (`docker run -p 8080:8080`, `local-ai run ...`) and serves an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost:8080. Startup is configurable entirely through flags and env vars (`--preload-models`/`PRELOAD_MODELS`, `--external-grpc-backends`, `LOCALAI_AUTH`), which suits servers and pipelines; the built-in web UI is an add-on rather than a requirement. Missing for 10: explicit docs on running without the web UI or disabling it, documented CI-pipeline usage examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
